title.en: A meal-planning agent receives eleven constraints and zero facts

goal.en: An AI planner is the role that may receive the most constraint types. Derive them and see that two facts about one household member (a medication and a schedule) collapse into one serve window with no times, no drug and no name.

note.en: Derive the planner's constraints from the example household.
The serve window is derived from two facets at once, the medication timing and the household schedule; the agent learns a window exists, not why.
Only two facets are withheld from a planner: the receiving rules (a grocer's business, not a planner's) and the firmware (consented, and no grant names a planner).
The same medication facet alone: it yields an avoid-ingredient rule and a serve window, and the facet's free text about timing never leaves.

outcome.en: Your planning agent can be built against DerivedConstraint documents only, which is also what the kitchen agent-safety benchmark expects. Next: 096 shows why recipe text is data for the same agent.
